units.title: Problem sets 1–10
examples: van der Waals vs ideal pressure
reversible vs irreversible work, q, ΔU, ΔH, ΔS, ΔG for an ideal gas

ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q for ATP
ΔH_sub, ΔH_vap and triple point from vapour pressures
notation: bar standard state; Kp vs Kc conversion
